integrity: The universal bound follows from the \(L^2\) boundary Parseval identity and Cauchy--Schwarz. A smooth unimodular boundary family, \(F_\varepsilon(e^{it})=e^{i\varepsilon\cos t}\), supplies a matching upper obstruction to first order. Taylor coefficients and strict comparison with the earlier reported radius are checked exactly; numerical samples are supplementary only.
scientific_limitations: The exact global radius \(R_H(a)\) is not determined for each \(a<1\); the result gives a strictly improved global lower bound and the sharp leading asymptotic as \(a\uparrow1\). It applies to all bounded complex-valued harmonic maps, not narrower sense-preserving subclasses. The terminal value \(a=1\) is understood in the supremum convention.
title: Sharp square-root boundary law for center-conditioned harmonic Bohr radii
